# Third-party code and fonts used by LockedIn

These files are hosted on our own site, so visitors' browsers don't contact other companies to load them.

| File | What it is | License |
|---|---|---|
| `supabase-2.57.4.js` | supabase-js 2.57.4 (database and sign-in library), copied from npm | MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase |
| `fonts/geist-*.woff2` | Geist and Geist Mono fonts by Vercel | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/instrument-serif-*.woff2` | Instrument Serif font by Instrument | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The font files were downloaded from Google Fonts (latin and latin-ext subsets only).
The SIL Open Font License allows using, copying and redistributing the fonts with software, but not selling the fonts on their own.
Full license texts: <https://opensource.org/license/mit> and <https://openfontlicense.org>.
